subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful `after_compaction` hooks gain a supported current-session reset capability once lifecycle ownership and proof are corrected?
rationale: This changes the shared plugin hook API and permanently grants hook subscribers a session-lifecycle operation, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended public contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook contract
options.body: Support `resetSession(reason?)` only for successful `after_compaction` hooks after the queue is moved to the outer lifecycle owner and real ordering proof is added.

options.title: Decline the shared reset API
options.body: Keep session rotation owner-controlled and solve the Remnic workflow through a narrower compaction-provider or owner-plugin lifecycle seam.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook contract
recommendation.body: Support `resetSession(reason?)` only for successful `after_compaction` hooks after the queue is moved to the outer lifecycle owner and real ordering proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most directly to the compaction/reset hook contract being extended.
